title: Maria C NDE 4541
content: I remember that I woke up with a headache, but I suffer from migraine since I was about five years old, this time I was thirty-three years old and I was three days with a bad headache. I went to my in-laws and my father-in-law gave me something for the pain but it wasn't getting better. After that I got home my husband went out, for a while after he got back, I was already vomiting and my pain got worst. I told him to take me to the emergency room, which he did. I remember in the hospital they injected me with some painkiller and I was feeling a little better. I do remember telling that I was sleepy and if I fell asleep to wake me up and not let me sleep for long. That is all I remember. He told me that I never woke up and the ambulance took me to another Hospital to do a CT scan, which showed that I was having a hemorrhage. At the time I fell asleep, I never woke up. So, they left me in the intensive care unit. My mom told me that I was in a comma for two weeks and that I did not have any reaction with the medication and treatments that I had done there. I clearly remember seeing myself walking through a tunnel. While I walked, well, it was like floating more than walking, I felt peace, no worries, angelical music, and a bright clear light like a star, like a diamond. At the end of the tunnel there was this man, he looked just like the pictures we see here of Jesus. He took me by my hand and said to me, 'This is not you time.' In a floating motion, he turned me around and sent me back. I know that after that, I saw a vision of a lot of people dying. It was like it was the end of mankind and ever since I still have these images in my head. My husband wanted to take me out of the machine, I have written proof of that, but my parents said no, so they tried another treatment and I woke up but with no memory at all. The only thing that I remember was what happened to me going through the tunnel. I did not know who I was, didn't know I had kids, totally memory loss. About two months after the hemorrhage, I was in the doctor's office, and as I was sitting, it was like a movie mostly of images came through, like a movie and I suddenly remembered my daughter, that I was pregnant but sadly that is still today I barely have a small amount of memory of my past. Don't remember when I was little; don't remember most of my friends and many other things. I still have three brain aneurisms and am just trying to survive.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: A man at the end of the tunnel who "looked just like the pictures we see here of Jesus" and said, "This is not you time."

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: The man at the end of the tunnel took her hand, turned her around, and "sent me back" while she was in a floating motion.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Brain hemorrhage (CT scan showed hemorrhage) following severe headache/vomiting; coma reported for two weeks.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Vision of many people dying / end of mankind after being sent back.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel with light and a Jesus-like figure at the end who states it is not her time and sends her back; afterward she reports a vision of many people dying.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: After being sent back, she reports a vision of "a lot of people dying" and "the end of mankind," with persistent images afterward. She also reports waking with profound retrograde amnesia and only remembering the tunnel experience.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "This is not you time."; "I clearly remember seeing myself walking through a tunnel."; "angelical music, and a bright clear light like a star, like a diamond."
